description: This file contains utility functions for user authentication, including sign-up, sign-in, password reset, OAuth login, and error handling, specifically tailored for a React frontend using Supabase as the backend.

methods.name: signUp
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password, with redirect URL configured for email confirmation.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Signs in a user using email and password credentials.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Sends a password reset email with a specific redirect URL.

methods.name: signInWithMagicLink
methods.description: Signs in user via email magic link, with redirect URL configured.

methods.name: signInWithOAuth
methods.description: Signs in user via OAuth provider like Google or GitHub.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Signs out the current authenticated user.

methods.name: handleAuthError
methods.description: Handles various authentication errors and provides user feedback via toast notifications, with specific handling for redirect issues, email confirmation, and invalid credentials.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user's data.
